Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Central University of Jammu Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the advertised positions at the Central University of Jammu is scheduled to be held on 30 September 2026. Candidates must report to the venue on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts, including Laboratory Assistant and Office Assistant, is 35 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criteria as of the date specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PwBD categories are exempted from paying the application fee. General and other category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500 via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Office Assistant (IIC) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the position of Office Assistant (IIC) will receive a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000. This is a contractual position based at the Central University of Jammu.

faq.question: Q5. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their original educational certificates, experience certificates, a valid ID proof, a duly filled application form, self-attested photocopies of all documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, these positions at the Central University of Jammu are purely on a contractual basis. The recruitment is conducted as per the terms and conditions mentioned in the official advertisement number CUJ/Admin/EN-Temp/2026/613.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification for Laboratory Assistant (ECE)?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Laboratory Assistant (ECE) post must possess a Diploma in Electronics & Communication with 3 years of experience, or a BE/B.Tech degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering.

faq.question: Q8. How to pay the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee of Rs. 500 must be paid in the form of a Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favor of the Registrar, Central University of Jammu. This DD must be submitted at the time of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Central University of Jammu, located in the Samba district of Jammu and Kashmir (Pincode: 181143). Please check the official notification for the specific department or building venue.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply online for these posts?
faq.answer: No, the recruitment process for these specific positions is through a walk-in interview mode only. Interested candidates are required to appear in person at the venue on the scheduled date with all necessary documents.
